intent: Australia measures almost 4,000 km from its westernmost to its easternmost point, while the Moon's diameter is 3,474 km, so laid across the continent the Moon would fall about 500 km short of the east coast.
pacing_profile: documentary: cold open, place, why in 2–5 beats, twist, close answers the open, short CTA (docs/STORY_GUIDELINES.md §2)
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses.
title: The country that is wider than the Moon

lines.direction: CRITICAL opener: wide high-altitude view of the Indian Ocean–Pacific rim, then a hyper-smooth kinetic plunge down onto the continent while the neon border draws itself; the push never stops
lines.text: This country is wider than the Moon. Not on a trick map. In kilometres.

lines.direction: dive onto Steep Point (pin + sonar ping); a plane takes off and the camera tracks it east across the whole continent; dive onto Cape Byron (pin + ping)
lines.text: Australia's westernmost point is Steep Point, a cliff on the Indian Ocean. Its easternmost is Cape Byron, a lighthouse on the Pacific.

lines.direction: pull back to the whole continent in one move; the neon width line draws west to east with the plane on its tip; the counter rolls to 3,990 (only text on screen)

the Moon — a disc of its true 3,474-km diameter — rolls in from the west and settles with its edge on Steep Point; counter 3,474; the camera slides east along the line to where the disc ends; pin + ping + flash; push in on the gap to the coast; card
lines.text: The Moon, edge to edge, is 3,474 kilometres. Lay it along the same line from Steep Point and it runs out here, in the outback of New South Wales, 500 kilometres short of the coast.

lines.direction: the disc lifts off the map and fades; long pull-out drifting west across the continent; the width line redraws with the plane; the border pulses
lines.text: The Moon is a sphere, so it still has far more surface than this one flat continent. But point to point, Australia is the wider of the two.

lines.direction: answer the opening line with the same noun
lines.text: One continent, coast to coast, wider than the Moon.

lines.direction: short follow — the outro visual does the work
lines.text: Follow for a new map story every day.
